Dlf Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on December 15, 2009, deliberated on the recommendations of the Special Committee and accepted the same by taking a decision for the in-principle integration (including by way of merger/ amalgamation) of DLF Cyber City Developers Ltd ("Cyber City") (a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company) with Caraf Builders & Constructions Pvt Ltd ("Caraf"). Dlf Limited has informed the Exchange that :"(1) Financial Year 2005-06 was the first year in which revised accounting standards prescribed by ICAI became applicable for construction / real estate development companies. DLF started using PoCM from FY 2005-06, prior to which all accounts were prepared in accordance with Conveyancing Method. (2) The Income Tax Department had provided to the company a report from the Special Auditor commissioned by the Department in December 2008 to evaluate the tax fillings for the Company for FY 2005-2006. The Special Report had recommended that the tax department (re)assess approximately Rs 1200 crores as additional income. (3) On May 6. 2009, the Assessing Officer, pursuant to audit and assessment proceeding has issued an assessment order adding substantially most of the amount suggested by the Special Audit Report. (4) The company has got an expert opinion on the enhanced taxable income and is confident that this addition will not be sustained by the appellate authorities. In an unlikely event if the said order is not reversed by the appellate authorities then it can result in a contingent liability of approx Rs. 300 to Rs. 400 crores".
